title: test(plugin-security): give each subject state its own it in the delegated-answer posture pin
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TEss82eNec4iJiaKw4MUFS)_

Fixes #31663

The card's preferred fix: the one `it` that looped every subject state through every door is split into one `it` per state, the same way in all three postures. Claim 6727396721 (`domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmSaqpcZzCHVZRYpzpW).

Clause-②: no — measured: test-only diff; no source file, request shape or answer changes, so nothing accepted on base is refused on head and nothing refused is accepted.
Metadata-protocol: none

`skip-changeset`: the diff is one test file under `src/` that the package does not ship (`plugin-security`'s `files[]` publishes `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; the built `dist/` holds zero hits for this test's title text, against a positive control, `DelegationScopeViolationError`, in 2 built files), so nothing any released package publishes changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：plugin-security 的一个权限测试原来把 4 种"目标用户状态"放在同一个用例里依次跑完，现在每种状态是自己的用例；参照答案（"不存在的用户 id"的答案）在 beforeAll 里只算一次，其余 3 种状态逐一与它比相等。三种租户姿态都同样改。
- 为什么改：4 次完整启动共用默认 5 秒超时，main 上 529e5351 那次 CI 分片负载高时超时了一次。拆开后每个用例只启动一次，有自己的 5 秒预算，失败时也能直接看出是哪种状态。
- 风险与回滚：只改测试文件，不改任何产品代码；断言一条没减，跨状态相等仍然保留。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` 第 878 行起的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` —— 预期 202 passed(main 上 193)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts`** — in the describe "a delegated answer about a user the caller cannot read does not depend on that user's existence or memberships", the `it` "the 4 states get, at every door, the answer the id naming no user gets" becomes a `describe` of that same title, per posture:
  - `beforeAll` asks every door once for the reference state, `an id naming no user` (one rig).
  - `it` "an id naming no user: the write gate's scope violation, and each explain door's refusal …" holds the reference answer's assertions, unchanged: `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` at the four write shapes, `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` at both explain doors, and the two `details` pins.
  - `it.each` over the other three states: each boots its own rig and asserts `toEqual(reference)`. That is the cross-state equality, kept as its own assertion per state, with the state as the failure label.
  - `beforeAll` joins the vitest import.
- Nothing else. No global `testTimeout`, no per-test timeout, no skip, no assertion removed or loosened. The forced test edit is this restructuring itself; no other test moved.

## Tests

Test count of the file: **106 → 115** on the first head (+3 per posture = 4 states − 1). After merging `origin/main` (`b126c1306`, which brought #31634's two describes into this file): **193 on main → 202 on head `8c1ef9f0`**, the same +9. The whole `plugin-security` suite on `8c1ef9f0`: **1280 files, 6079 tests: 6034 passed, 45 skipped, 0 failed**.

Slowest case, 20 consecutive runs of the file each side (`vitest run --maxWorkers=3 --sequence.concurrent=false`; 3 is CI's `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS` on the 4-core runner, read from `scripts/vitest-worker-cap.mjs`), under `os-verify-lock`, on a 4-core shared container:

| Posture | Base `5d1382a5`: the one `it` (p50 / p99 / max) | Head `c2516ef6`: slowest state `it` (p50 / p99 / max) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| single | 761 / 847 / 847 ms | 209 / 271 / 271 ms |
| group | 783 / 918 / 918 ms | 212 / 298 / 298 ms |
| isolated | 789 / 904 / 904 ms | 222 / 281 / 281 ms |

On the merged head `8c1ef9f0`, 20/20 more runs green, 202/202 each; the slowest split state's p99 is 252 / 268 / 254 ms (group / isolated / single), and the slowest test in the file is the untouched `ground truth` `it` at 685 ms.

Slowest case on `c2516ef6`: **298 ms**, posture `group`, state "a user whose business unit is outside the scope". The reference `it` itself takes 2–4 ms (the boot is in the `beforeAll`). In the full-suite run under the package's own load, the slowest split case was 242 ms. 20/20 runs green on base and 20/20 on head.

Reading: on this box the old `it` used about a fifth of its 5 s budget; CI's timeout came from shard load (Test Core 8/8 runs several packages at once), which this box does not reproduce. After the split each `it` carries one rig, about a quarter of the old work, against the same 5 s budget.

## Acceptance notes

- The `ground truth: the delegate reads the subject exactly in the states where it is a user the delegate may read` `it` in the same describe also loops (five rigs, read door only): p99 705–782 ms on base, 737–760 ms on head over the same 20 runs. It is lighter than the split loop was (one read per state, not six doors) and outside this card's Fix; noted, not changed.

## Verification

**Merge of `origin/main` (`8c1ef9f0`).** `main` moved 19 commits; #31634 (`18cdcb20`) edited this file. The only conflict was the vitest import line (both sides added `beforeAll`); it resolves to main's line, `describe, it, expect, afterEach, beforeAll, afterAll, vi`. #31634's tests are kept byte-for-byte: `git diff origin/main` on the file is exactly this PR's split (+28 / -15). Its describes do not carry the card's shape (their per-state refusals already share one `beforeAll` rig per state), so nothing of theirs was split. On `8c1ef9f0`: 20 × the file under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0; whole suite as above; `typecheck` VERDICT command-exit 0; eslint exit 0; `dispatch-gates --commands` the same 53, all exit 0, `--ran` 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. CI on `8c1ef9f0`: every check suite completed with no failure.

Round 1, all on head `c2516ef6`, after its last commit:

<details><summary>Commands and verdicts</summary>

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='@objectstack/plugin-security^...'` then `--filter='./packages/**'` under `os-verify-lock`: VERDICT command-exit 0 both.
- 20 × `vitest run --maxWorkers=3 --sequence.concurrent=false src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` on base and on head, one lock hold each: VERDICT command-exit 0, every run exit 0.
- `vitest run --maxWorkers=3` (whole `plugin-security`) under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, 5933 passed / 45 skipped / 0 failed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, 0 errors).
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-security`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 53 commands, all run, all exit 0. Three first answered exit 3 (prerequisite not met) and were re-run green after their prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (after fetching its pinned fixture commit), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` (after the full package build). `--ran` reconciliation: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Ablation: n/a. The diff changes no behaviour a test pins; it regroups the same assertions.

</details>
